label: Dali ni horbo
note: Boiled and set with pineapple juice or papaya leaf juice (it also tames the strong smell, per Indonesia Travel); a Batak staple sold in the markets (onan) of Tapanuli

about.text: A cheese of the Batak people of Tapanuli, North Sumatra: water buffalo milk is boiled and curdled with pineapple juice or papaya leaf juice.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
Batak; buffalo milk boiled, set with papaya leaf or unripe pineapple juice

facts.v: Water buffalo, milked early morning; about 2 L a day taken, the rest left to the calf
